disclaimer: Education, not financial advice. AI exposure isn't replacement.

scenes.headline: ChatGPT can write your CV. It can't fix your roof.
scenes.voiceover: ChatGPT can write your CV. It can't fix your roof. Microsoft researchers studied two hundred thousand real conversations with an AI chatbot, to find the work it helps with the least. We turned that list into ten businesses you can start in South Africa. And number one is something you walk on every day.

scenes.headline: Microsoft's 40 US jobs AI chatbots apply to least
scenes.body: Lowest position = our #1. Two-job businesses take the lower position. Hard to replace, not impossible.
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (July 2025 pre-print), US data
scenes.voiceover: Here's how we ranked them. Microsoft listed the forty American jobs where AI chatbots apply the least. Our order follows each job's position on that list. It's a twenty twenty-five study that hasn't been peer reviewed yet, using US data, and the researchers say every kind of work has some exposure to AI. So think of these as hard to replace, not impossible.

scenes.headline: Painting & plastering
scenes.voiceover: Number ten.

scenes.headline: Every wall is different
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data · position #37

stat.label: of 40 jobs AI applies to least (Microsoft, US)

scenes.voiceover: Painting and plastering. On Microsoft's list, helpers to painters and plasterers sit at number thirty-seven. Every wall is different: cracks, damp, old paint, and a client standing next to you. A chatbot can describe a perfect finish, but it can't hold a roller.

scenes.name: Painting & plastering
scenes.headline: Rollers, brushes, a ladder, and a good teacher
scenes.receipt: MMM starter checklist, not a study
scenes.voiceover: To start, you need rollers, brushes, a ladder and drop sheets. The best way to learn is to work alongside an experienced painter first.

scenes.name: Painting & plastering
scenes.headline: Let AI work out the paint and the quote
scenes.receipt: MMM suggestion, not a study
scenes.voiceover: Where AI can help: give it the room sizes, and it can estimate how much paint you need and turn that into a neat written quote.

scenes.headline: Auto glass fitment
scenes.voiceover: Number nine.

scenes.headline: Precise, physical, and done on the spot
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data · position #33

stat.label: of 40 jobs AI applies to least (Microsoft, US)

scenes.voiceover: Auto glass fitment. Automotive glass installers are number thirty-three on the list. Lifting a windscreen into a car and sealing it properly is careful, physical work, often done right at the customer's car.

scenes.name: Auto glass fitment
scenes.headline: Suction lifters, adhesive, and proper training
scenes.receipt: MMM starter checklist, not a study
scenes.voiceover: You'd need suction lifters, the right adhesive and proper training in fitting, because a badly fitted windscreen is a safety problem.

scenes.name: Auto glass fitment
scenes.headline: Never miss a WhatsApp booking
scenes.receipt: MMM suggestion, not a study
scenes.voiceover: AI can help you answer booking messages on WhatsApp quickly, even when your hands are full.

scenes.headline: Tyre fitment & repair
scenes.voiceover: Number eight.

scenes.headline: Hands on the wheel, every time
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data · position #31

stat.label: of 40 jobs AI applies to least (Microsoft, US)

scenes.voiceover: Tyre fitment and repair. Tyre repairers and changers come in at number thirty-one. Every car that rolls in needs real hands on the wheel, and no chatbot can fix a puncture.

scenes.name: Tyre fitment & repair
scenes.headline: Tools, and a plan for old tyres
scenes.receipt: Waste Tyre Regulations, 2017 (NEM: Waste Act) · gov.za
scenes.voiceover: You'll need a tyre changer, a wheel balancer and a compressor. And in South Africa, the Waste Tyre Regulations of twenty seventeen set out duties for tyre dealers, including how old tyres must be handled.

scenes.name: Tyre fitment & repair
scenes.headline: Track stock and get found on Google
scenes.receipt: MMM suggestion, not a study
scenes.voiceover: AI can help you keep track of your stock, and write your Google business listing so drivers nearby can find you.

scenes.headline: Forklift operation & hire
scenes.voiceover: Number seven.

scenes.headline: Real loads, real warehouses
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data · position #21

stat.label: of 40 jobs AI applies to least (Microsoft, US)

scenes.voiceover: Forklift operation and hire. Industrial truck and tractor operators, including forklift drivers, are number twenty-one. Moving real loads safely through a busy warehouse is not something a chatbot does.

scenes.name: Forklift operation & hire
scenes.headline: A certificate from an accredited trainer
scenes.receipt: Driven Machinery Regulations, 2015, reg. 18(11) (OHS Act) · acts.co.za
scenes.voiceover: Here the law is clear. Under South Africa's Driven Machinery Regulations, an operator of a listed lifting machine must hold a certificate of training from an accredited training provider.

scenes.name: Forklift operation & hire
scenes.headline: Scheduling and invoices, sorted
scenes.receipt: MMM suggestion, not a study
scenes.voiceover: AI can help you schedule jobs, and send invoices on time.

scenes.headline: Massage & spa
scenes.voiceover: Number six.

scenes.headline: Skilled hands and trust
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data · position #19

stat.label: of 40 jobs AI applies to least (Microsoft, US)

scenes.voiceover: Massage and spa. Massage therapists are number nineteen. People pay for skilled hands and a calm, trusted space, which a chatbot can't give them.

scenes.name: Massage & spa
scenes.headline: Training, and know the rules
scenes.receipt: AHPCSA · SAQA professional designation 472
scenes.voiceover: Get proper training first. And know this: in South Africa, a registered therapeutic massage therapist is a professional registered with the Allied Health Professions Council, the A H P C S A.

scenes.name: Massage & spa
scenes.headline: Bookings and reminders on autopilot
scenes.receipt: MMM suggestion, not a study
scenes.voiceover: AI can help with bookings and appointment reminders, so fewer clients forget to show up.

scenes.headline: Roofing
scenes.voiceover: Number five.

scenes.headline: Up on the roof, in the sun and wind
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data · position #14 & #16

stat.label: of 40 jobs AI applies to least (Microsoft, US)

scenes.voiceover: Roofing. Roofers are number fourteen on the list, and their helpers number sixteen. The work happens up on the roof, in the sun and wind, on houses that are all built a little differently.

scenes.name: Roofing
scenes.headline: Safety gear first, then tools
scenes.receipt: MMM starter checklist, not a study
scenes.voiceover: Start with safety gear for working at heights, then a good drill, ladders and the right fixings.

scenes.name: Roofing
scenes.headline: Turn photos into neat quotes
scenes.receipt: MMM suggestion, not a study
scenes.voiceover: AI can help you turn your photos and measurements into a clear, professional quote.

scenes.headline: Home cleaning
scenes.voiceover: Number four.

scenes.headline: Every home is different
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data · position #12

stat.label: of 40 jobs AI applies to least (Microsoft, US)

scenes.voiceover: Home cleaning, for private households. Maids and housekeeping cleaners are number twelve. Every home is different, and the job needs someone physically there, someone the family trusts.

scenes.name: Home cleaning
scenes.headline: Supplies, reliability and references
scenes.receipt: MMM starter checklist, not a study
scenes.voiceover: It's one of the cheapest businesses to start: good supplies, reliable transport, and references from happy clients.

scenes.name: Home cleaning
scenes.headline: Plan routes and repeat bookings
scenes.receipt: MMM suggestion, not a study
scenes.voiceover: AI can help you plan the day's route between clients, and manage weekly repeat bookings.

scenes.headline: Paving & driveways
scenes.voiceover: Number three.

scenes.headline: Heavy, outdoor, site-by-site work
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data · position #11

stat.label: of 40 jobs AI applies to least (Microsoft, US)

scenes.voiceover: Paving and driveways. Paving and surfacing operators are number eleven. Every driveway has its own slope, soil and drainage, and the bricks have to be laid by hand.

scenes.name: Paving & driveways
scenes.headline: A compactor, mallets and a good supplier
scenes.receipt: MMM starter checklist, not a study
scenes.voiceover: You'll need a plate compactor, rubber mallets, a level, and a reliable supplier for bricks and sand.

scenes.name: Paving & driveways
scenes.headline: Show clients the pattern first
scenes.receipt: MMM suggestion, not a study
scenes.voiceover: AI image tools can help you show a client different paving patterns before the first brick goes down.

scenes.headline: Boat skipper & charter
scenes.voiceover: Number two.

scenes.headline: The sea doesn't follow a script
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data · position #9

stat.label: of 40 jobs AI applies to least (Microsoft, US)

scenes.voiceover: Boat skipper and charter. Motorboat operators are number nine. Weather, tides and passengers change every trip, and someone has to be in charge on the water.

scenes.name: Boat skipper & charter
scenes.headline: A SAMSA certificate of competence
scenes.receipt: SAMSA (South African Maritime Safety Authority) small vessel rules
scenes.voiceover: This one is regulated. For a commercial vessel in South Africa, the skipper must be over eighteen and hold a suitably endorsed certificate of competence, issued under SAMSA's rules.

scenes.name: Boat skipper & charter
scenes.headline: Bookings and forecasts, but you decide
scenes.receipt: MMM suggestion, not a study
scenes.voiceover: AI can help with bookings and summarise the forecast, but the skipper still makes the call.

scenes.headline: Why aren't plumbers and electricians here?
scenes.body: They're not in Microsoft's bottom 40. That doesn't mean AI can do their jobs. They just weren't among the very lowest.
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data
scenes.voiceover: Before number one, a question you might be asking: where are plumbers and electricians? They're not in Microsoft's bottom forty. That doesn't mean AI can do their jobs. It just means they weren't among the very lowest scores.

scenes.headline: Floor finishing
scenes.voiceover: Number one.

scenes.headline: Every floor tells its own story
scenes.receipt: Microsoft Research, 'Working with AI' (2025 pre-print), US data · position #7 & #23

stat.label: of 40 jobs AI applies to least (Microsoft, US)

scenes.voiceover: Floor finishing: sanding, screeding and polished concrete. Floor sanders and finishers are number seven on Microsoft's list, the lowest position of any business here, and cement masons and concrete finishers come in at twenty-three. Old wood, uneven concrete, dust and noise: every floor is different, and the finish depends on skilled hands.

scenes.name: Floor finishing
scenes.headline: A sander, an edger and dust extraction
scenes.receipt: MMM starter checklist, not a study
scenes.voiceover: You'll need a floor sander, an edger, good dust extraction and a polisher, plus practice on real floors before you charge for it.

scenes.name: Floor finishing
scenes.headline: Before-and-after posts that sell
scenes.receipt: MMM suggestion, not a study
scenes.voiceover: And AI can help you write the before-and-after posts that bring in your next client.

scenes.headline: Skilled hands. AI back office.
scenes.voiceover: See the pattern? The work itself needs skilled hands, in a real place, for a real person. But the back office, the quotes, bookings, invoices and marketing, is exactly where AI can make a small business faster. The owners who use both will have the edge.

scenes.headline: Check the rules for your trade
scenes.body: Educational only, not financial advice. AI exposure isn't replacement, and no business is guaranteed.
scenes.voiceover: Before you start anything, check the rules and training for your trade, and talk to people already doing it. This video is education, not financial advice, and no business is guaranteed to succeed.

scenes.voiceover: Which of these would you start? Tell us in the comments. All our sources are in the description.

tags: businesses to start in South Africa
youtube.description:
Jobs AI can't easily replace: 10 hands-on businesses you can start in South Africa. For each one we cover why AI struggles with it, what you need first, and how AI can still help you run it.

How we ranked them: each business takes its position on Microsoft Research's 2025 list of the 40 US jobs where AI chatbots apply least (lowest position = #1). A business that combines two jobs takes its lower position.

{chapters}

Sources:
Ranking: Microsoft Research, Tomlinson et al., "Working with AI: Measuring the Occupational Implications of Generative AI" (pre-print, July 2025). It is based on 200,000 anonymised Bing Copilot conversations (US, 2024). We used its list of the 40 occupations with the lowest AI applicability. Positions used: floor sanders & finishers 7; cement masons & concrete finishers 23; motorboat operators 9; paving, surfacing & tamping equipment operators 11; maids & housekeeping cleaners 12; roofers 14; helpers–roofers 16; massage therapists 19; industrial truck & tractor operators 21; tire repairers & changers 31; automotive glass installers & repairers 33; helpers–painters, plasterers 37. The researchers note that all occupations have some potential for AI impact, and that overlap does not mean replacement.
Context: World Economic Forum, Future of Jobs Report 2025 (frontline roles such as farmworkers, delivery drivers and construction workers see the largest job growth to 2030). ILO Working Paper 140 (2025), Generative AI and Jobs: A Refined Global Index of Occupational Exposure.
SA rules mentioned: Waste Tyre Regulations, 2017 (National Environmental Management: Waste Act); Driven Machinery Regulations, 2015, regulation 18(11) (Occupational Health and Safety Act); Allied Health Professions Council of South Africa (AHPCSA), Registered Therapeutic Massage Therapist (SAQA designation 472); South African Maritime Safety Authority (SAMSA), small vessel certificates of competence.
"What you need first" checklists and "How AI can help" tips are MMM suggestions, not findings of any study.
